interface.longDescription: Stealth Commander lets you connect ChatGPT to a Windows computer you own or administer. Sign in to your Stealth Commander account, select a paired PC, and use the tools exposed by the secure remote MCP connection for authorized machine operations and status checks. Depending on the installed client, supported workflows can include running commands, inspecting hidden desktop sessions, and accessing observability features. The paired PC must be online, and access is scoped to the selected device and its Windows account. Some browser and native-desktop capture workflows remain under private testing. The service requires OAuth sign-in and explicit device consent. Do not connect devices that you do not own or have permission to manage.
defaultPrompt: Show the status of my paired Windows PC.
List the tools available on my connected PC.
Check which hidden desktop sessions are active.
